query: SELECT DISTINCT u.id, u.email AS "email!" FROM users u WHERE u.state = 'active' AND u.notify_budget_alerts AND u.email IS NOT NULL AND ( u.id IN (SELECT user_id FROM project_memberships WHERE project_id = $1 AND preset = 'admin') OR u.id IN (SELECT m.user_id FROM org_memberships m JOIN projects p ON p.org_id = m.org_id WHERE p.id = $1 AND m.preset IN ('owner', 'admin')))
